notes.Algae: Simple water plants, like pond scum or seaweed

notes.Andromeda: Nearest big galaxy to the Milky Way
notes.Asteroid Belt: Ring of rocks between Mars and Jupiter

notes.Bay: Curved stretch of coastline with water

notes.Bonsai: Miniature tree grown in a pot (Japanese art)
notes.Butte: Small flat-topped hill with steep sides
notes.Carnation: Frilly flower often worn in buttonholes

notes.Drought: Long period with little or no rain

notes.Equinox: Day when day and night are equally long (spring or autumn)
notes.Estuary: Where a river meets the sea
notes.Fern: Green plant with feathery leaves and no flowers

notes.Flood: Water overflowing onto normally dry land
notes.Frost: Thin ice crystals on surfaces on cold mornings
notes.Geode: Plain rock that hides sparkling crystals inside

notes.Gorge: Deep narrow valley with rock walls
notes.Granite: Hard speckled rock used for countertops

notes.Hot Spring: Natural pool of warm underground water

notes.Lagoon: Calm shallow water separated from the sea
notes.Landslide: Earth and rocks sliding down a slope
notes.Lavender: Purple flowering herb with a calming smell
notes.Lichen: Crusty growth on rocks and trees (fungus + algae)
notes.Light-Year: Distance light travels in a year
notes.Limestone: Pale rock formed from sea shells

notes.Magma: Molten rock under the Earth's surface
notes.Magnolia: Tree with big waxy white-pink flowers
notes.Mangrove: Tree that grows in salty coastal water on stilt-like roots
notes.Maple Tree: Tree with five-pointed leaves; Canada's symbol
notes.Meadow: Open field of grass and wildflowers

notes.Mirage: Optical illusion of water in a hot desert
notes.Mistletoe: Plant you kiss under at Christmas
notes.Molehill: Little mound of soil dug up by a mole
notes.Monsoon: Seasonal heavy rains in South Asia

notes.Nebula: Giant colourful cloud of gas and dust in space
notes.Neptune: Farthest planet, deep blue and windy
notes.North Star: Polaris, the star that marks north

notes.Oasis: Green spot with water in a desert
notes.Orbit: Curved path around a planet or star
